title: nan
authors: Cheng C.; Wang H.; Yu Y.; Huang J.; Yang D.
key_contribution: Presents an initialization method for monocular visual-inertial navigation using IMU pre-integration, visual Structure-from-Motion, and loosely coupled estimation of scale, gravity, and IMU biases.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Filter_Based_VIO to ensure precise positioning.
